headline: North Korea linked to massive Binance crypto heist
summary: FBI attributes a $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korea. The attack, labeled "TraderTraitor," occurred on October 29th. Hackers are converting stolen tokens to Ethereum for laundering.

headline: HomePod Mini 2 first look: Three things I love and one disappointment
summary: Apple's new $149 HomePod Mini 2 offers minor upgrades. It features a chip bump, new color options, and improved AirPlay. The reviewer expresses disappointment over the limited enhancements after six years.

headline: New Zelda and GTA represent a games industry that no longer exists
summary: This column argues that new Zelda and GTA releases signify a bygone era. The author reflects on the changing landscape of the games industry. It's part of "The Stepback" weekly newsletter.

headline: Prop 45 in California could be hiding a loophole for data centers
summary: California's Prop 45 aims to fast-track "essential" infrastructure projects. Environmental advocates fear it creates a loophole for data centers to avoid scrutiny. The measure would shorten environmental assessment timelines and hinder legal challenges.

headline: Everyone Is Running a Con in You Can See Everything
summary: The Elizabeth Holmes documentary, "You Can See Everything," is described. The film reportedly depicts widespread deception among its subjects. Everyone involved seems to be operating a "con."

headline: UK Deals: AliExpress Has a Ton of Early Black Friday Deals for Gamers
summary: AliExpress is offering early Black Friday deals in the UK. Discounts include gaming and PC tech. Nintendo Switch 2 consoles are available from £335.52.

headline: Input Lag Is So Bad in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on Nintendo Switch 2 That Players Suffer From a 'Competitive Disadvantage'
summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on Nintendo Switch 2 suffers from severe input lag. This lag creates a significant competitive disadvantage for players. The issue is reported to be worse than on other platforms.

headline: Save Mass Effect Graffiti Reportedly Spray-Painted Outside EA Building
summary: "Save Mass Effect" graffiti appeared on an EA office building in Madrid. This vandalism follows EA's announcement of shuttering BioWare, the series developer. Fans express distress over the future of the Mass Effect franchise.

headline: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
summary: Cost-of-living protests in German cities, including Berlin and Frankfurt, turned violent. Shops were looted amidst the unrest. This coincides with similar large-scale protests in France.

headline: Healey risks breaking minimum wage promise for younger workers
summary: The Chancellor, Healey, suggested that younger workers might not receive the promised minimum wage. This potential policy shift could occur before the next election. Critics express concern over the fairness to younger demographics.

headline: Five teenagers stabbed at Halloween party
summary: Five teenagers were stabbed at a Halloween party in Chandler's Ford. Hampshire Police believe an unknown group gained unauthorized entry. Investigations are ongoing into the violent incident.

headline: University of Cambridge scientist among those who died in Spanish train crash
summary: Marta Shahbazi, a University of Cambridge scientist, died in a Spanish train crash. Her laboratory described her as an "inspiring, talented, and passionate scientist." The incident has led to an outpouring of grief for the accomplished researcher.
